changed_files.description: Every file the stage edited or created, worktree-relative. THE SENTINEL RE-DERIVES THIS FROM THE FILESYSTEM AND OVERRIDES IT -- a stage that under-reports what it touched is the case this field exists to expose, not to be believed about.

summary.description: What was changed and why, in prose a reviewer reads before the diff.

regression_test.description: The test that fails without the fix and passes with it. Null is honest when none could be written, and the controller then refuses to verify -- a fix with no regression test cannot be re-checked, which is invariant 3 one layer up from the reproduction.

path.description: Worktree-relative path of the test file.

test_name.description: The test function's name, so the verifier can select it rather than running the whole suite and hoping.

notes.description: Anything the stage wants on the record. An empty implement stage says so here rather than inventing a change.
